description: MVP venue universe (iap.mvp): the two bundled equity venues XV1 and XV2 copied verbatim from configs/venues/venues.json plus a third synthetic equity venue XV3. venue_id 3 is free in the platform id space (venues.json uses 1, 2, 10, 11, 12; the contracts golden example already renders venue 3 as XV3). XV3 profile (documented, plausible): slightly cheaper taker fee than XV1/XV2 (0.0025/share), the lowest maker rebate (0.001/share) and the slowest latency (300 us mean, 100 us jitter) - within sor.max_venue_latency_ns (1 ms) and the 2 ms latency budget, so it is eligible but only wins aggressive routes on price or on a fee tie. Same latency model as venues.json: receive_ts = exchange_ts + mean_ns + jitter (uniform in [0, jitter_ns], SplitMix64).
